test_title: PYST 43: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, 'PARENT' is written as ‘11, 26, 9, 22, 13, 7’ and ‘DUMPSTER’ is written as ‘23, 6, 14, 11, 8, 7, 22, 9’. How will ‘FLASK’ be written in that language?
solution:
Explanation:

The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Opposite positional values are written in code language.

 
• PARENT → 11, 26, 9, 22, 13, 7

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6e6504ea7f575cc1cd27111ddb1a56dcba0a8f8e8f4091f8b72dc1948d0ba95.png] 
 
• Code = 11, 26, 9, 22, 13, 7
 
 

 

 
• DUMPSTER → 23, 6, 14, 11, 8, 7, 22, 9

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e5e230317a6df5f67800f9a0915f64a5ffa51a10541963ee98ca84faad13d47.png] 
 
• Code = 23, 6, 14, 11, 8, 7, 22, 9
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, FLASK → ?​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2402f285e51f6b6455f99841dbeefb165b2100931c04a09fe4ca659d95969028.png] 
 
• Code = 21, 15, 26, 8, 16
 
 
• We get '21, 15, 26, 8, 16'
 
 
 
 

​Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
